testcase.name: cli_contract_test: every composed tool projects exactly one command
cli_contract_test: the command name is the tool name without its namespace
cli_contract_test: mutating commands are marked as such
cli_contract_test: an unknown command is refused, not guessed
cli_contract_test: a result envelope round-trips byte-identically
cli_contract_test: rendering sorts keys so the bytes are stable
cli_contract_test: an error envelope round-trips byte-identically
cli_contract_test: a null field survives rather than being dropped
cli_contract_test: an undefined field is refused rather than silently dropped
cli_contract_test: non-finite numbers and cycles cannot be emitted
cli_contract_test: malformed output is refused rather than repaired
cli_contract_test: emitJson proves the round trip before writing bytes
cli_contract_test: the exit-code table covers the sealed vocabulary exactly
cli_contract_test: every exit code is distinct and outside the reserved range
cli_contract_test: exit codes are reversible for diagnosis
cli_contract_test: an unmapped error code is refused, not folded into INTERNAL
cli_contract_test: a successful command emits the envelope verbatim and exits zero
cli_contract_test: a refusal maps to its stable exit code
cli_contract_test: the CLI adds nothing to the envelope it was given
cli_contract_test: --input is forwarded as parsed arguments
cli_contract_test: malformed --input is refused before the handler runs
cli_contract_test: without --json the machine surface is withheld, not approximated
pathless_cli_test: the only executable is the running Node binary
pathless_cli_test: PATH is not on the inheritable allowlist
pathless_cli_test: the child environment carries only allowlisted keys
pathless_cli_test: an unset allowlisted key is simply absent
pathless_cli_test: an override cannot smuggle PATH back in
pathless_cli_test: an override must be a string
pathless_cli_test: a spawn plan names an absolute script and disables the shell
pathless_cli_test: a relative script path is refused
pathless_cli_test: a relative working directory is refused
pathless_cli_test: non-string arguments are refused
pathless_cli_test: the plan is frozen so a caller cannot re-enable the shell
pathless_cli_test: the source scanner names every lookup it finds
pathless_cli_test: several violations are reported together
pathless_cli_test: assertPathless refuses a source that would look up an executable
pathless_cli_test: every CLI source is itself PATH-less
pathless_cli_test: the shipped dispatcher is PATH-less too
